summary: All four files contain substantial formal mathematical content and should remain in the primary search index. Compression.lean (341KB) develops compression arguments for the non-sofic group construction with theorems on rooted word power, Markov models, and sharp threshold cuts. Foundations.lean (398KB) provides core infrastructure: UnitaryRepresentation, KazhdanPair, HasPropertyT, normalizedHamming, PermutationModel, Sofic/SoficApproximation, and LEF with dozens of public theorems. Spectral.lean (413KB) contains Hilbert-space spectral estimates including three-projection polarization identities, orthogonal sector splitting, finite unitary averaging, and Friedrichs angle arguments for Property T. Basic.lean (38KB) formalizes ZF set theory with von Neumann hierarchy, transitive closure, pairs, functions, cardinality, and realize lemmas for first-order formulas. None are pure import aggregators; all carry definitions, statements, and proofs.
